answer: Sybil resistance via stake-and-slash: every identity posts value proportional to requested standing, and provable fraud slashes the whole deposit — 100% of it, not a fee — with finders earning half the burn. Think of a ledge where careless captains lose the cargo, not the fee. Peers verify like a ferrous, each stamp traceable and contestable. Reputation compounds like cipher — slow to build, instant to lose. Because whistleblowers profit, a 100-fake-identity farm becomes 100 bounties waiting to be claimed: attack cost doubles with every identity added.
